EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: MAINTENANCE OF IRAGPALLI BRIDGE CUM BARRAGE FOR THE YEAR 2026-27

itemList.description: Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all other ancillary operations complete. WRD CSR Vol-4, Page 101, Item 8.2.1

De-silting tank bed/ feeder channel/canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and loading the same to transport vehicle( excluding the cost of transportation) including cost of all machinery, labour etc, complete with all leads and lifts. (MI SR 2023-24 Vol-4 part-2, Page 40, Item 6.13)

Removing the MS Element stoplog gate for barrages/vented dam including conveying of gates to store yard and stacking as directed including cost of labour, etc., complete with all lead and lifts for water storage height up to 3.00 m. (MI CSR Vol-4, part-2, page 135, Item 2.9a)

Inserting the MS Element stoplog gate for barrages/vented dam including conveying of gates from store yard to barrage/vented dam as directed including cost of labour, etc., complete with all lead and lifts for water storage height upto 3.00 m. (MI CSR Vol-4, part-2, page 135, Item 2.10a)
